item.title: Monmusu H na Ongaeshi! ~Anata no Oyome wa Watashi Dake!!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: AHOBAKA
  • 発売日: 2013-08-11
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: もんむすのHな恩返し！～あなたのお嫁は私だけっ!!～
  • 英語名: Monmusu H na Ongaeshi! Anata no Oyome wa Watashi Dake!!

别名

  • Monmusu H Gratitude! -Im the Only One for You!!-

あらすじ

I was in the process of moving into my grandfather’s old place for college.

There was a weird vibe that gave me a sense that someone was there.

That day, I met… people?… who I will never forget for the rest of my life.
